verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm selling legal services, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence mentions client extranets and Fenwick Labs web services, but nothing shows the firm offers an API, any credential issuance, or permission scoping that would make the axis apply. The probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
